brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net can you make a faux facebook meme page “I fucking love paperclips” with some pages of posts to scroll through? on the model of ‘’ science, but, y know, they like paperclips instead

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@apenwarr.ca: The paperclip maximizers were never the AIs
  [quoting @rincewind.run: go to hell (image, alt text: "From a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world's limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer and being used 5% of the time," Altman said. "You want maximum utilization in the cloud if you're trying to deal with this very supply-constrained environment. And somehow many people's intuition is the opposite of that.")]

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
